# mock-gun

> Mailgun-compatible mock server for local/CI use. Accepts the same "send
> message" API calls a real app would send to Mailgun, captures them instead
> of delivering real email, and exposes a JSON introspection API so QA agents
> and test frameworks can list, fetch, wait for, and clear captured messages
> during a test run.

## Docs

- [API.md](API.md): full endpoint reference — auth, the Mailgun-compatible
  send/domain/template endpoints, and the introspection API (list/get/wait/delete
  messages) that QA agents and test frameworks should use to assert on
  emails sent during tests.

## Notes

- All endpoints except `/admin` and `/data` require HTTP Basic auth: username
  `api`, password is the `MOCK_MAILGUN_KEY` env var.
- The introspection API is additive — it does not change the Mailgun-compatible
  send/domain/template endpoints.
- Base path for a running instance is whatever host:port it's deployed at
  (e.g. `http://localhost:8000`); there is no fixed public URL.
